editor.starterBody:
# Commercial proposal

[[organization.name]], [[today]]

To [[company.name]]
Attn. [[contact.name]]

## Scope

We are pleased to present the proposal **[[deal.title]]**, prepared by [[owner.name]].

## Items

[[items_table]]

## Terms

- Total: **[[items.total]]**
- This proposal is valid for 15 days from [[today]]

---

Kind regards,
[[user.name]]
[[organization.name]]
